fact: The national identification agency ANID's teams carried out biometric registration across the regions to build the national identification register.
Togo chose MOSIP, an open-source identity platform, to build the infrastructure, which the article says lets the country keep control of it.
Togo's national digital ID system is MOSIP-based, an open-source platform, under a 2021 MoU; an Atos and Idemia consortium implements mostly the technical aspects.
The national biometric identification agency ANID opened fifty enrolment centres at Atakpame, bringing the Plateaux region in after the Savanes, Grand Lome and Maritime, says the government portal.
The deck says the e-ID Togo system is based on the open source MOSIP platform, with no vendor lock-in.
